method: BASE-only instruction-following diagnostic on two registered training families, four predeclared attempts.

independent_review.child_attempt_result: Budget exhausted; no saved child assertion receipts or returned patch.

verified_setup_defect.description: The pinned upstream child constructor omitted the parent orchestrator setting, so a parent configured with orchestrator=False spawned a child with the default True.
verified_setup_defect.effect: Appended orchestration instructions contradicted the child REPL protocol, including claiming sub-models have no REPL.
verified_setup_defect.repair: Preserve the parent orchestrator value when constructing a recursive child.

limitations: This tests the unchanged BASE on training tasks, not learning or fresh generalization.
Functional direct repairs do not count as genuine recursive completions.
The configuration fix is not evidence of learned improvement; both model arms need fresh matched evaluation.
The source mismatch may contribute to failure; it does not explain every observed code or finalization error.
